request.raw_text: Left side of the whistle is missing radii. Add radii to the edges of the bigger part of the whistle. Radii must be same as the ones on the other side

areas_to_change.reference_geometry: The currently sharp exterior edges on the left side of the enlarged end portion of the whistle, corresponding to the radiused edges on its opposite side.
areas_to_change.location: Left lateral side of the larger, bulbous end body where it joins and surrounds the narrower elongated whistle body.
areas_to_change.description: Round the missing exterior edges using the existing opposite-side fillets as the geometric template. Match their radius, extent, and edge-transition treatment to make the enlarged portion bilaterally consistent.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Existing radii on the opposite side of the enlarged whistle body
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve their geometry and use their radius and transition style as the reference for the new fillets.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Narrow elongated whistle body and its stepped connection to the enlarged end
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Do not alter its overall length, cross-section, steps, or existing edge treatments except where a selected enlarged-body edge requires a continuous matching fillet.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Circular opening and rectangular recessed or slotted feature
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve their positions, sizes, orientations, and functional clearances.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Overall external dimensions and existing rounded lower profile of the enlarged end
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Maintain the current envelope and profile apart from material removal caused by the new matching edge radii.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: The enlarged end of the whistle will have matching rounded exterior edges on both lateral sides, replacing the identified sharp left-side edges with fillets equal to those on the opposite side.
predicted_final_outcome.function: The edit will remove unintended sharp edges, improve handling, and provide a more symmetric and manufacturable outer body without changing the whistle passages or openings.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: The whistle should retain its existing functional behavior while gaining consistent edge transitions and improved tactile safety on the enlarged portion.
